question: Which of these ports is located on the Western Coastal Plain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cochin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cochin (Kochi)** is located on the Western Coastal Plain of India in the state of Kerala.
 
• It is one of the major ports on the Malabar Coast, which is part of the western coast of India.
 
• The port is strategically important for trade and is known for its natural harbor.
 
• Cochin has historically been a hub for spice trade and is referred to as the "Queen of the Arabian Sea."
 
• The Western Coastal Plain spans Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, and Kerala, and Cochin is a significant port in this region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Coastal Plain:**

 
 
• It is a narrow strip of land between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea.
 
• The plain includes regions such as the Malabar Coast, Konkan Coast, and Gujarat Coast.
 
• The Western Coastal Plain is characterized by lagoons, estuaries, and backwaters.
 
• Important rivers such as Narmada, Tapi, Mandovi, and Periyar flow through this region.
 
 
 
• **Natural Harbors in India:**
 
 
• A natural harbor is a water body protected from waves and currents, making it suitable for docking ships.
 
• India has several natural harbors, including Cochin, Mumbai, and Marmagao.
 
 
 
• **Cochin Port:**
 
 
• It is one of the largest ports in India and handles bulk cargo, including spices, tea, and seafood.
 
• Cochin Port is also a gateway for international trade and tourism in the region.
 
• The port has modern facilities for container handling and cargo transportation.
 
 
 
• **Paradip, Visakhapatnam, and Chennai Ports:**
 
 
• Paradip is located in Odisha on the eastern coast of India.
 
• Visakhapatnam is a major port in Andhra Pradesh along the eastern coastal plain.
 
• Chennai is situated on the eastern coast in Tamil Nadu and is also known as a hub for trade and commerce.
